Maya (CS): hey folks — i start coverage on Ty's west-coast book today. need HubSpot support seat, Dialpad softphone + phone number, and the short CS handoff checklist. who should i ask? cc @Ty
Ty (Sales): welcome Maya! :wave: i'll DM the account priority flags. ping Hannah for seats. quick note: include "Gong Listen" if you want recordings, and request a direct dial if you'll be doing outbound setup calls.
Maya (CS): thanks. for HubSpot is 'support_user' okay or do i need deal-edit to log notes on expansions?
Hannah (IT): hi Maya — default for CS is support_user which includes contact/ticket edit. if you need deal edits request role=support_plus with a short justification. fastest is the slash command: 
```
/seat-request --product hubspot --role support_user --user maya@redwood.ai --reason "CS onboarding - west coast book"
```
Dialpad: 
```
/seat-request --product dialpad --seat-type softphone --user maya@redwood.ai --request-number=true --region=us-west
```
Add hardware=true if you need a headset.
Maya (CS): perfect. can someone paste the one-page handoff checklist? want to skim before the sync.
Ravi (CS Lead): pasting condensed checklist — customize per account:
"1) Intro email within 24h; 2) Confirm access to integration docs; 3) Schedule 30m setup call; 4) Assign onboarding tasks; 5) First-week check-in day 3; 6) Escalation contact list."
Ty (Sales): i'll include call snippets from the demo and the Gong sequence id in the DM. pro tip: tag account tier in the ticket so CS knows SLA.
Maya (CS): great — will slot the intro template into Gong. anyone know who handles number porting if i need a dedicated line?
Ops (Hardware): hi Maya — ops handles numbers. include request_number=true and specify if you want porting. hardware shipping handled in 48h for US addresses.
onboarding-bot: Ticket #4901 created: HubSpot (support_user), Dialpad (softphone + number request), Gong Listen. ETA: 1 business day.
Maya (CS): awesome, thanks. can we do a 20-min sync tomorrow at 10:30 PT to run through the top 5 accounts? i'm free 10:00-11:30.
Ty (Sales): 10:30 PT works, invite sent. i'll bring account notes and two demo clips.
Hannah (IT): provisioning queued. ping me if you need an expedited turn.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone :seedling:
